gloss: to take the place of, to be substituted

definitions.gloss: to take the place of, to replace, to substitute for
definitions.explanation: For one thing or person to serve in place of another. The subject takes over the role or function of something else.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}が{代|か}わりに{行|い}きます。
{電話|でんわ}を{代|か}わってもらえますか。
examples.english: Could you put someone else on the phone?

examples.japanese: AIが{人間|にんげん}に{代|か}わって{多|おお}くの{仕事|しごと}をこなす{時代|じだい}が{来|き}ている。
examples.english: An era is coming where AI handles many tasks in place of humans.

notes:
{代|か}わる is an intransitive godan verb meaning for something to take the place of something else. The transitive pair is {代|か}える.

TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
・Pair: {代|か}える (transitive — to substitute)
・Pattern: AがBに{代|か}わる (A takes the place of B)

ASPECT (ている):
・{代|か}わっている = has replaced, is acting as a substitute (resulting state)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・AがBに{代|か}わる (A replaces B)
・Aに{代|か}わって (in place of A, on behalf of A)
・{代|か}わりに (instead, in place of — very common)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{代|か}わる: to take the place of, to be substituted (intransitive)
・{変|か}わる: to change, to be altered (modification of state)
・{換|か}わる / {替|か}わる: to be exchanged, to be swapped

cross_references.notes: Transitive pair — 代える means to substitute (something)
変わる means to change — different kanji, different meaning
